content.title: Lizzo! Joe Jonas! Snoop Dogg! See All the Surprise Guests at 2026 Coachella
content.text: The annual music festival's first weekend was star-studded Published on April 13, 2026 01:15PM EDT Snoop Dogg in April 2026; Joe Jonas in April 2026; Lizzo in April 2026. Credit : Matt Winkelmeyer/Getty; Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty; Arturo Holmes/Getty NEED TO KNOW Coachella 2026's first weekend featured headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol GSurprise guests included Lizzo, Joe Jonas, Snoop Dogg, Jennifer Lopez, Travis Barker and moreThe second weekend of Coachella goes down April 17-19 The first weekend of Coachella 2026 is a wrap! The annual Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival kicked off at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, Calif., with its first weekend from April 10-12 and featured headlining performances from Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G. Additional headliner Anyma's Friday set was canceled due to weather concerns, but he performed alongside Marlon Hoffstadt at the festival's Do LaB stage on Sunday. Over the three-day event, dozens of special guests appeared for surprise performances. Lizzo, Joe Jonas, Snoop Dogg, Camila Cabello, Jennifer Lopez, Billy Corgan, HUNTR/X, Kehlani, Travis Barker and more artists hit the stage unannounced.
